description: E5ap with server-side call windows: AgentProvenance v0.9.0 runs next to FACT in the same E5 rounds, but each ToolCallScope binding carries the window measured inside the MCP server (handler entry to exit, --server-windows) instead of the client's, which includes queueing. Isolates the effect of the window definition on AgentProvenance's attribution (control for E5ap).
